args.code:
# The XOR decoding logic:
# edx starts at 0xffffffa0 (which is -96 as signed, or 4294967200 as unsigned)
# For each character at position i:
#   1. XOR input[i] with (edx & 0xFF) 
#   2. Compare result with byte at 0x402040+i
#   3. Add input[i] to edx

# So: input[i] ^ (edx & 0xFF) = expected[i]
# Therefore: input[i] = expected[i] ^ (edx & 0xFF)
# Then update edx = (edx + input[i]) & 0xFFFFFFFF

expected = bytes([0xe6, 0xaa, 0x73, 0x34, 0xc1, 0x53, 0xfe, 0x72, 0x00, 0x8d, 0x28, 0xc1, 0x7a, 0xec, 0x8d, 0x3f,
                  0xdd, 0x4e, 0xe2, 0x5d, 0x57, 0xa1, 0xff, 0xc7, 0x4a])

edx = 0xffffffa0  # Starting value

result = []
for i in range(25):
    # XOR to decode
    char = expected[i] ^ (edx & 0xFF)
    result.append(char)
    # Update edx
    edx = (edx + char) & 0xFFFFFFFF

decoded = bytes(result)
print("Decoded:", decoded)
print("As string:", decoded.decode('latin-1'))
